description: Windows control center for live hardware monitoring, drivers, apps, storage analysis, cleanup, and hardware tests.
notes: Uses the official portable ZIP and its StellarHub.portable marker; settings, history, logs, and the WebView2 profile are stored in the persistent Data directory beside the app.
Machine-specific rollback backups are deliberately kept in ProgramData by the application.
Some maintenance and driver operations require administrator approval when used.
The built-in updater can replace files inside the Scoop-managed folder when you choose Update now; use Scoop to update StellarHub instead.
